name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS)
disclaimer: Informative only. Not a substitute for reading the published standard.

entries.title: Understanding the organization and its context
entries.summary: Determine external and internal issues relevant to the organization's purpose and AIMS.

entries.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
entries.summary: Identify interested parties relevant to the AIMS and their requirements regarding AI systems.

entries.title: Determining the scope of the AI management system
entries.summary: Define the boundaries and applicability of the AI management system.

entries.title: Leadership and commitment
entries.summary: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the AIMS.

entries.title: AI Policy
entries.summary: Top management shall establish an AI policy appropriate to the purpose of the organization.

entries.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
entries.summary: Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles in the AIMS.

entries.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
entries.summary: Determine risks and opportunities related to AI systems and plan actions to address them.

entries.title: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
entries.summary: Establish measurable AI objectives at relevant functions and levels.

entries.title: Resources
entries.summary: Determine and provide resources needed for the establishment, implementation, and continual improvement of the AIMS.

entries.title: Competence
entries.summary: Ensure personnel operating or managing AI systems are competent on the basis of education, training, or experience.

entries.title: Awareness
entries.summary: Ensure persons doing work under the organization's control are aware of the AI policy and their contribution to AIMS effectiveness.

entries.title: Documented information
entries.summary: Maintain and control documented information required by the AIMS.

entries.title: Operational planning and control
entries.summary: Plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet AI system requirements and implement actions from clause 6.

entries.title: AI risk assessment
entries.summary: Perform AI risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

entries.title: AI system impact assessment
entries.summary: Assess potential impacts of AI systems on individuals, groups, and society throughout their lifecycle.

entries.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
entries.summary: Determine what needs to be monitored and measured to evaluate AIMS performance.

entries.title: Internal audit
entries.summary: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the AIMS conforms to requirements.

entries.title: Management review
entries.summary: Top management shall review the organization's AIMS at planned intervals.

entries.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
entries.summary: React to nonconformities, evaluate the need for action to eliminate causes, and implement corrective actions.

entries.title: Continual improvement
entries.summary: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the AIMS.

entries.title: Alignment with organizational policies
entries.summary: Ensure AI system management policies align with broader organizational risk and governance policies.

entries.title: AI system roles and responsibilities
entries.summary: Define and document roles and responsibilities specific to AI system design, development, and operation.

entries.title: Human resources for AI systems
entries.summary: Ensure sufficient qualified personnel are assigned to AI system development and oversight.

entries.title: Assessing AI system impacts
entries.summary: Conduct documented AI system impact assessments prior to deployment.

entries.title: AI system lifecycle management
entries.summary: Manage AI systems across all lifecycle phases from conception to retirement.

entries.title: Verification and validation of AI systems
entries.summary: Perform verification and validation of AI systems to ensure requirements are fulfilled.

entries.title: Data management for AI systems
entries.summary: Establish governance processes for training, validation, and testing data quality and provenance.

entries.title: Information for users of AI systems
entries.summary: Provide appropriate transparency and technical information to users regarding AI system capabilities and limitations.

entries.title: Responsible use of AI systems
entries.summary: Define guidance and boundaries for acceptable use of AI systems by internal users.

entries.title: Supplier relationships for AI systems
entries.summary: Assess and manage risks associated with third-party AI system components and suppliers.
